responsibility: This header declares the core GNU Modula-2 runtime system interface for mc-boot. It exposes module-construction entry points, registration and dependency requests, installation and execution of initial/termination procedures, HALT and diagnostic services, runtime LENGTH support, and the set of exported language-exception raising hooks that generated code and libraries call when runtime semantic checks fail.
same_name_distinction: Declares the central runtime API consumed by generated code and libraries, while GM2RTS.cc supplies the internal procedure-list machinery, startup/termination control, and concrete runtime fault raisers.
